decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk builds on the firm's office furniture expertise and its own R&D. That lets it read market feedback and refine the system, and demand for flexible workplaces is growing.
A chair family sits at the core of the firm's craftsmanship and design knowledge. Its results are easy to interpret, and its variants can be extended across residential and office lines.
Floor cushions made from carpets draw on the firm's material expertise but are a small accessory. They stay for now as a low-cost complement, though they are more vulnerable than the core furniture.
The designer sofa by EOOS is close to the firm's established upholstery competence and its designer collaborations. The firm can fully absorb market feedback, so it remains a flagship.
The high standing table closely matches existing table and conference know-how. It fits flexible workplace trends and can be improved with little extra learning.

The rug collection is distant from the firm's furniture knowledge base, which limits its ability to interpret results and improve the textile products. The released resources are better spent on core furniture development.
